# Overview {.unnumbered}

This task list plans how Group 5 will address the deficiencies in our CEP proposal (Chapters 1 to 3), based on Dr. Jung's Proposal Evaluation Form. Dr. Jung noted that these are the main deficiencies and that more comments may come in future readings, so this list will be updated as new feedback arrives.
